description.value: The Tuwanek is a small, adult-oriented luxury waterfront B&B on the Sunshine Coast just north of Sechelt, offering two themed king-suite rooms (African Queen and Casablanca) with ocean views, wood-burning fireplaces, and private decks. The property sits directly on the water and includes a spa, hot tub, steam cave, sandy beach, kayaks, canoe, and stand-up paddleboards. It is accessible via the Horseshoe Bay–Langdale ferry followed by a 40-minute drive up the coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the property is a 2-room adult-only waterfront B&B near Sechelt on the Sunshine Coast, with spa services, hot tub, kayaks, and a Tesla charging station. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash station, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site. Nearby food options are referenced explicitly: 'Lighthouse Pub So Good Anytime!' and 'Saffron They Deliver!' appear as local recommendations on the front page.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'The Tuwanek Hotel and Spa' but the website header and branding consistently use 'THE TUWANEK BED AND BREAKFAST'; the footer uses 'TUWANEK HOTEL AND SPA'. The OSM category 'hotel' does not reflect the 2-room B&B nature of the property.
Property is explicitly adult-oriented and couples-focused ('NO PETS. ADULT ORIENTED FOR COUPLES'), which may limit its relevance for general touring cyclists.
OSM community field says 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but the property is on the Sunshine Coast mainland (Sechelt area), not Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands.
Tesla charging station is mentioned but cannot be confirmed as usable for e-bike charging without further verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure knowledge) can be confirmed from the website. The property is a romantic couples-only retreat with no cycling infrastructure mentioned; direct outreach would be needed to determine if it meets minimum WWC standards.
